pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Slower hunger, growing with the tier, up to +35%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)9 of any flowers$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)any flowers$(li)any leaves$(li)Glass or Glass Pane$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Glass encloses flora.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Glass: Glass or Glass Pane$(li)Flora: any flowers
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: Worth more for standing near the right neighbours - never required, only rewarded:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/alchemy_lab)Alchemy Lab$(/l), with a way through between them, up to 12 blocks long$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/apiary)Apiary$(/l), within 12 blocks$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/farm)Farm$(/l), within 12 blocks
pages.title: Rooms that go together

pages.text: And rooms that do not go with it - each one costs this room while it stands there:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/cold_storage)Cold Storage$(/l), sharing a wall
pages.title: Rooms that do not
